# Generic credential-bound Devgraph v2 fixtures

Generated by `server/tests/devgraph_work_v2.rs` from the unchanged Work/Arena
fixtures in `../named-work-v1/requests.json` and `../arena-v1/requests.json`.
Synthetic Ed25519 seeds are 32 repetitions of byte 37 (holder) and byte 43
(authority); both are public test inputs with no live grants. The test binds
full request, idempotency, attested disclosure, generic holder presentation and
v2 projection while asserting every original request digest remains unchanged.

Retain the repository license and the original Work/Arena fixture provenance
and notices in their source directories. This generation record is not an
additional permission grant or relicensing. No private runtime configuration
is copied.

Generation is explicit, not automatic during ordinary tests:

```text
SECS_TEST_V2_FIXTURE_OUTPUT=/private/tmp/new-vectors.json cargo test --locked -p server --test devgraph_work_v2 all_work_arena_vectors
```

Review generated differences before replacing `signed-vectors.json`. Consumer
repositories should retain this provenance and verify exact canonical bytes.
